meta.title: TELIP | EC-TEL 2026 Workshop
meta.description: TELIP — EC-TEL 2026 workshop on interdisciplinary project-based learning and a TEL research agenda for the next decade.

header.title: Technology Enhanced Learning in Project-based Learning
header.subtitle: The Next Decade of Interdisciplinary Project-based Learning in Higher Education and at the Workplace: Outlining a TEL-Research Agenda

about.title: About the workshop
about.lead: The TELIP workshop brings together researchers and practitioners to map the next decade of TEL research on interdisciplinary project-based learning (iPBL) in higher education and at the workplace. Drawing on case presentations and structured group work, participants will identify practical challenges, outline a shared research agenda, and establish collaboration networks — with the aim of co-authoring an agenda article and forming project consortia.
about.conference: TELIP is held at the Twenty-first European Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning (ECTEL 2026), themed Mindful TEL: Learning Technologies Shaped with Intention, in Valencia, Spain (14–18 September 2026).
about.audience: Researchers in CSCL/CSCW, learning analytics, AI, and boundary-crossing work, together with practitioners — managers, teachers, coaches, and facilitators — involved in interdisciplinary project-based learning. We expect around 30 participants.
outcomes: A collaboratively shaped research agenda for iPBL in higher education and workplace settings
Priority research questions agreed through plenary voting
Foundations for co-authoring an agenda article and forming project consortia
about.survey: A short survey will be circulated before the workshop to gather scientific perspectives and help form breakout subgroups. Survey link — to be announced.

topics.title: Topics & goals
topics: Team development, reflexivity, and dynamics in interdisciplinary teams
Epistemic awareness and boundary crossing across disciplines
Collaborative knowledge building and metacognitive scaffolding
Learning analytics and AI for team-based learning
Organisational scaling and sustainability of interdisciplinary learning
goals: Identify practical challenges of iPBL in higher education and workplace settings
Clarify similarities and differences across application domains
Outline a research agenda through structured subgroup work
Decide on priority research questions via plenary voting
Initiate co-authorship of an agenda article and project consortia formation

format.title: Workshop format
format.intro: TELIP is a three-part hybrid workshop combining plenary sessions and breakout work:
steps: Case presentations — plenary challenge identification from real iPBL cases in higher education and workplace contexts.
Research agenda formulation — structured breakout groups translate challenges into research directions.
Synthesis & planning — working-group presentations, plenary voting on priority questions, and follow-up planning for publications and consortia.
format.note: Detailed schedule (times, rooms) will be published after the EC-TEL programme is confirmed.

cfp.title: Call for contributions
cfp.lead: We invite researchers and practitioners to contribute case presentations and perspectives on interdisciplinary project-based learning. Contribution formats and review process will be announced after workshop acceptance.
cfp.note: Workshop contributions are not included in the main EC-TEL Springer proceedings. Organisers may pursue independent publication routes (e.g. workshop report or agenda article).
